WITH rating_rates AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(length) AS avg_length,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_rate
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
), overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_per_day_rate) AS mean_per_day_rate
  FROM rating_rates
)
SELECT
  rr.rating,
  rr.avg_length,
  rr.avg_per_day_rate,
  rr.avg_per_day_rate - om.mean_per_day_rate AS avg_excess
FROM rating_rates AS rr
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om
WHERE rr.avg_per_day_rate > om.mean_per_day_rate

assumptions.assumption: Each film’s per-day rate is rental_rate divided by rental_duration; the rating’s per-day rate is the average of those film-level rates. AVG(length) ignores NULL lengths as requested. The comparison mean is the simple average of the five rating-level rates, so each rating counts once.
